name: {namespace}
description: Work with your workhorses, the agents that do sustained work for this workbench. There is one workhorse for each checkout, and it works in that checkout. Every tool but stop_workhorses takes checkout: the directory where that workhorse runs. Called from a script, a tool resolves to one string of JSON holding its whole result: print it with text(result). It is not an object, and it has no content array.

tools.name: inspect_workhorse
tools.description: Read what the workhorse of one checkout is doing now: the turn it runs, the request that started its newest turn and that turn's recent progress, the sub-agents it spawned, the requests waiting for it, and what its last stop observed. A read that failed or that is not allowed is named in unavailable, and its field is then empty for that reason. Returns at once.

tools.name: delegate_to_workhorse
tools.description: Give the workhorse of one checkout one piece of sustained work, written in English with the conversation context it needs. If that checkout has no workhorse yet, this starts one.

tools.name: manage_workhorse_queue
tools.description: See or change the requests waiting for the workhorse of one checkout to finish what it is doing.

tools.name: steer_workhorse
tools.description: Add one short instruction, such as a correction, to the turn the workhorse of one checkout is running now. Works only while a turn is running.

tools.name: stop_workhorses
tools.description: Stop all work of this conversation, in every checkout, when the person asks to stop: the turn of each workhorse, every sub-agent it spawned and every request waiting for it. Returns once the stop saw that work end, or after a few seconds with what still runs. One entry for each workhorse: stopped or idle when all its work ended, partial when some still runs or waits, unconfirmed when some could not be read. remaining names that work, and recovery names the tools that recover. Until a stop ends all its work, the workhorse refuses new work.
